summary: Kinross Gold filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 6, 2026, announcing that it will report third-quarter 2026 financial statements and operating results on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, after market close, followed by a conference call and audio webcast on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. EDT with a question-and-answer session. Replay details and webcast access were provided. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. This is a routine earnings-date scheduling notice, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
